plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: goalify sets up a big coding task to run autonomously: it scopes the work, locks the few real decisions, writes a self-contained implementation brief, and derives the /goal completion condition from it — because /goal takes a condition string, never a file path — so a fresh session executes the whole job and has to prove every success criterion before it stops.
